content: Hahoi Job ni a pathung teh,

content.text: Ka lawk he kahawicalah na thai pouh haw,
Hetheh nangmouh lungmawng nahanelah awmseh.
Ka dei navah panguep awh ei,
be ka dei hnukkhu hoi na panuikhai awh vai nei.
Ka phuenangnae heh tami tarannae lah maw ao.
Hottelah awm pawiteh, bang kecu dawk maw, ka lung a saw thai hoeh.
Na khen awh haw, kângairu awh naseh.
Na pahni hah tabuem awh.
Ka pouk nah ka pâyaw
takinae ni ka kâha a uek sak.
Bang kecu dawk maw tamikathoutnaw ni a matawng totouh a hring awh teh,
thaonae dawk bahu ao han vaw.
A ca catounnaw hah amamae mithmu vah a kung acaksak awh,
amamae miphun hah amamae hmalah acaksak awh.
A imnaw hah takinae thung hoi a hlout teh,
Cathut e sonron hah ahnimae a lathueng bawt boihoeh.
Maitotan ni cati tu laipalah awm boihoeh.
Maitomanu ni ca khe laipalah awm boihoeh.
Saringhu patetlah a canaw a tâco sak teh,
a canaw teh a lam awh.
Tamawi hoi ratoung kueng laihoi la a sak awh,
Tamawi e a lawk dawk hoi a lunghawi awh.
Hringnawmnae hoi atueng aloum sak awh teh
dongdengca dawk phuen vah a cei awh.
Hateiteh, Cathut koe
na cettakhai yawkaw,
na lamthung panue hane heh ka ngai awh hoeh.
Athakasaipounge, a thaw ka tawk pouh hane teh apimaw,
Ama koe ka ratoum navah ahawinae bangmaw ka mek telah ati awh.
A tawn awh e hno hah amamae kut dawk kaawm e ka tang nahoeh,
tami kathoutnaw khokhangnae teh, kaimouh koehoi kahlatpoung la ao.
Tamikathoutnaw e hmaiim teh, bangmaw atuhoitu a due teh,
amamae rawkphainae teh, bangmaw atuhoitu a pha.
Lungmathoenae hah Cathut ni a lungkhueknae dawk hoi lawk ouk a ceng boimaw
Kahlî dawk e cakong patetlah ao teh,
kahlî ni palek e vaikong patetlah ao awh.
Cathut ni a canaw hanelah, payonpakai nahan a ta telah a ti.
Panuethai awh nahanelah, ahnimouh teh ama ni patho naseh.
A ronae hah a mit hoi hmawt sak awh,
Athakasaipounge lungkhueknae manang hah net sak awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a thapa akuep totouh atueng baw sak lah o teh,
ama a rawk hnukkhu hoi a im teh, banglahai tho hoeh.
Karasang lah kaawm e hai lawkcengkung Cathut teh
apinimaw panuenae a cangkhai thai han.
Lungmawngcalah hoi karoumcalah ao nah koe,
tami buet touh a thao lahun nah a due.
A sanunaw hai sanutui abuem awh teh,
a hrunaw hai rakhing hoi akawi.
Tami alouke buet touh, a nawmnae roeroe awm laipalah,
lungmathoe nalaihoi a due.
Vaiphu dawk reikâvan lah a i roi,
tangraet ni muen a kayo.
Khenhaw! na pouknae naw hah ka panue.
Ka lan hoeh poung e kai dawk
sak han na noe e hah ka panue.
Nâmaw bawi im teh a o,
nâmaw tamikathoutnaw khosaknae
rim teh ao telah na ti awh.
Kahlawng ka cet e hah na pacei boihoeh na maw.
Mitnoutnae naw hah na panuek awh hoeh maw
Tamikathoutnaw teh, lawkcengnae hnin hanelah
pouk tangcoung e lah ao awh.
Lungkhueknae hnin nah tâcokhai lah ao awh han,
tie hah na panuek hoeh maw
Apinimaw a hmaitung vah na lamthung hah hawihoeh atipouh han.
Apinimaw a sak e hah a patho han.
Hateiteh, phuen koe ceikhai lah ao teh,
phuen hah meng kountouk hanelah ao.
Ayawn dawk e kacoumnaw hah,
ahnimouh hanlah, a radip vaiteh, tami pueng ni a kâbang han.
A hmalah touklek hoeh e ka cet tangcoungnaw patetlah
taminaw pueng a duksawn han telah a ti.
Hottelah namamae pahni dawk laithoe pou ao lahun nah,
bangtelamaw hrawnghrang lawk hoi
lung khuet na pahawi thai awh han, telah a ti.
